arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ فِي الِاعْتِرَافِ و طَلَبِ التَوبَةِ الى الله
english_title: 12.His Supplication in Confession and in Seeking Repentance toward God

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّهُ يَحْجُبُنِي عَنْ مَسْأَلَتِكَ خِلاَلٌ ثَلاثٌ
phrases.english: O God, three traits have prevented me from asking Thee

phrases.arabic: وَتَحْدُونِي عَلَيْهَا خَلَّةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ ،
phrases.english: and one trait has urged me on:

phrases.arabic: يَحْجُبُنِي أَمْرٌ أَمَرْتَ بِهِ فَأَبْطَأتُ عَنْهُ،
phrases.english: I am prevented by a command Thou hast commanded in which I have been slow,

phrases.arabic: وَنَهْيٌ نَهَيْتَنِي عَنْهُ فَأَسْرَعْتُ إلَيْهِ،
phrases.english: a prohibition Thou hast prohibited toward which I have hurried,

phrases.arabic: وَنِعْمَةٌ أَنْعَمْتَ بِهَا عَلَيَّ فَقَصَّرْتُ فِي شُكْرِهَـا.
phrases.english: and a favour through which Thou hast favoured for which I have not given sufficient thanks.

phrases.arabic: وَيَحْدُونِي عَلَى مَسْأَلَتِكَ تَفَضُّلُكَ
phrases.english: I am urged to ask Thee by Thy gratuitous bounty

phrases.arabic: عَلَى مَنْ أَقْبَلَ بِوَجْهِهِ إلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: upon him who turns his face toward Thee

phrases.arabic: وَوَفَدَ بِحُسْنِ ظَنِّـهِ إلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: and comes to Thee with a good opinion,

phrases.arabic: إذْ جَمِيعُ إحْسَانِكَ تَفَضُّلٌ،
phrases.english: since all Thy beneficence is gratuitous bounty

phrases.arabic: وَإذْ كُلُّ نِعَمِكَ ابْتِدَاءٌ.
phrases.english: and every one of Thy favours a new beginning!

phrases.arabic: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا يَا إلهِيْ وَاقِفٌ بِبَابِ عِزِّكَ
phrases.english: So here I am, my God, standing at the gate of Thy might,

phrases.arabic: وُقُوفَ المُسْتَسْلِمِ الذَّلِيْل، وَسَائِلُكَ عَلَى الْحَيَاءِ مِنّي
phrases.english: the standing of the lowly, the surrendered, asking Thee in my shame,

phrases.arabic: سُؤَالَ الْبَائِسِ الْمُعِيْلِ. مُقـرٌّ لَكَ بأَنّي
phrases.english: the asking of the destitute, the pitiful, admitting to Thee that

phrases.arabic: لَمْ أَسْتَسْلِمْ وَقْتَ إحْسَانِـكَ إلاَّ بِالاِقْلاَعِ عَنْ عِصْيَانِكَ،
phrases.english: at the time of Thy beneficence I surrendered not save through abstaining from disobedience toward Thee

phrases.arabic: وَلَمْ أَخْلُ فِي الْحَالاتِ كُلِّهَا مِنِ امْتِنَانِكَ.
phrases.english: and in none of my states was I ever without Thy Kindness.

phrases.arabic: فَهَلْ يَنْفَعُنِي يَا إلهِي إقْرَارِي عِنْدَكَ بِسُوءِ مَا اكْتَسَبْتُ؟
phrases.english: 6- Will it profit me, my God, to admit to Thee the evil of what I have earned?

phrases.arabic: وَهَلْ يُنْجِيْنِي مِنْكَ اعْتِرَافِي لَكَ بِقَبِيْحِ مَا ارْتَكَبْتُ؟
phrases.english: Will it save me from Thee to confess the ugliness of what I have done?

phrases.arabic: أَمْ أَوْجَبْتَ لِي فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا سُخْطَكَ؟
phrases.english: Or wilt Thou impose upon me in this my stationThy displeasure?

phrases.arabic: أَمْ لَزِمَنِي فِي وَقْتِ دُعَائِي مَقْتُكَ؟
phrases.english: Will Thy hate hold fast to me in the time of my supplication?

phrases.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! لاَ أَيْأَسُ مِنْكَ وَقَدْ فَتَحْتَ لِيَ بَابَ التَّوْبَةِ إلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: Glory be to Thee! I do not despair of Thee, for Thou hast opened the door of repentance toward Thyself.

phrases.arabic: بَلْ أَقُولُ مَقَالَ الْعَبْدِ الذَّلِيلِ الظَّالِمِ لِنَفْسِهِ
phrases.english: Rather, I say, the words of a lowly servant,   having wronged himself

phrases.arabic: الْمُسْتَخِفِّ بِحُرْمَةِ رَبِّهِ
phrases.english: and made light of his Lord's inviolability,

phrases.arabic: الَّذِي عَظُمَتْ ذُنُوبُهُ فَجَلَّتْ وَأَدْبَرَتْ أَيّامُهُ فَوَلَّتْ
phrases.english: and whose sins are dreadful, great,whose days have parted, fled,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى إذَا رَأى مُدَّةَ الْعَمَلِ قَدِ انْقَضَتْ
phrases.english: until, when he sees the term of his works expired and the limit of his lifetime reached

phrases.arabic: وَغَايَةَ الْعُمُرِ قَدِ انْتَهَتْ ،
phrases.english: and knows with certainty that he has no escape from Thee,

phrases.arabic: وَأَيْقَنَ أَنَّهُ لا مَحيصَ لَهُ مِنْكَ ،وَلاَ مَهْرَبَ لَهُ عَنْكَ
phrases.english: no place to flee from Thee, he turns his face toward Thee in repeated turning,

phrases.arabic: تَلَقَّاكَ بِالإنَابَةِ ،وَأَخْلَصَ لَكَ التَّوْبَةَ
phrases.english: makes his repentance toward Thee sincere,stands before Thee with a pure and purified heart,

phrases.arabic: ، فَقَامَ إلَيْكَ بِقَلْبِ طَاهِر نَقِيٍّ
phrases.english: then supplicates Thee with a feeble, quiet voice.

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ دَعَاكَ بِصَوْت حَائِل خَفِيٍّ ،
phrases.english: He is bowed before Thee, bent,

phrases.arabic: قَدْ تَطَأطَأَ لَكَ فَانْحَنى، وَنَكَّسَ رَأسَهُ فَانْثَنَى ،
phrases.english: his head lowered, thrown down,

phrases.arabic: قَدْ أَرْعَشَتْ خَشْيَتُهُ رِجْلَيْهِ، وَغَرَّقَتْ دُمُوعُهُ خَدَّيْهِ ،
phrases.english: his legs shaking in fear,his tears flooding his cheeks.

phrases.arabic: يَدْعُوكَ بِيَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ وَيَا أَرْحَمَ مَنِ انْتَابَهُ الْمُسْتَرْحِمُونَ،
phrases.english: He supplicates Thee: O Most Merciful of the merciful!O Most Merciful of those toward whom seekers of mercy keep on turning

phrases.arabic: وَيَا أَعْطَفَ مَنْ أَطَافَ بِهِ الْمُسْتَغْفِرُونَ ،
phrases.english: O Tenderest of those around whom run seekers of forgiveness!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ عَفْوُهُ أكْثَرُ مِنْ نِقْمَتِهِ،
phrases.english: O He whose pardon is greater than His vengeance!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ رِضَاهُ أَوْفَرُ مِنْ سَخَطِهِ،
phrases.english: O He whose good pleasure is more abundant than His anger

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ تَحَمَّدَ إلَى خَلْقِهِ بِحُسْنِ التَّجاوُزِ ،
phrases.english: O He who seeks His creatures' praise with excellent forbearance!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ عَوَّدَ عِبادَهُ قَبُولَ الإنَابَةِ ،
phrases.english: O He who has accustomed His servants to the acceptance of their repeated turning!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنِ اسْتَصْلَحَ فَاسِدَهُمْ بِالتَّوْبَةِ
phrases.english: O He who seeks to heal their corruption through repentance!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ رَضِيَ مِنْ فِعْلِهِمْ بِالْيَسيرِ،
phrases.english: O He who is pleased with the easy of their acts!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ كَافى قَلِيْلَهُمْ بِالْكَثِيرِ،
phrases.english: O He who recompenses with the much their little!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ ضَمِنَ لَهُمْ إجَابَةَ الدُّعاءِ،
phrases.english: O He who has made himself accountable to them to respond to supplication!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ وَعَدَهُمْ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِتَفَضُّلِهِ حُسْنَ الْجَزاءِ،
phrases.english: O He who pledged Himself by His gratuitous bounty to give them excellent repayment!

phrases.arabic: مَا أَنَا بِأَعْصَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ فَغَفَرْتَ لَهُ،
phrases.english: I am not the most disobedient of those who have disobeyed Thee

phrases.arabic: وَمَا أَنَا بِأَلْوَمِ مَنِ اعْتَذَرَ إلَيْكَ فَقَبِلْتَ مِنْهُ،
phrases.english: and whom Thou hast forgiven, nor am I the most blameworthy to offer excuses which Thou hast accepted,

phrases.arabic: وَمَا أَنَا بِأَظْلَمِ مَنْ تَابَ إلَيْكَ فَعُدْتَ عَلَيْهِ ،
phrases.english: nor am I the most wrongdoing of those who have repented to Thee, and to whom Thou hast returned

phrases.arabic: أَتُوبُ إلَيْكَ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا تَوْبَةَ نَادِم عَلَى مَا فَرَطَ مِنْهُ
phrases.english: I repent to Thee in this my station,  the repentance of one remorseful over what preceded from him

phrases.arabic: مُشْفِق مِمَّا اجْتَمَعَ عَلَيْهِ خَالِصِ الْحَيَاءِ مِمَّا وَقَعَ فِيْهِ ،
phrases.english: hastily, apprehensive of what has gathered around him, pure in shame for that into which he has fallen,

phrases.arabic: عَالِم بِأَنَّ الْعَفْوَ عَنِ الذَّنْبِ الْعَظِيمِ لاَ يَتَعـاظَمُكَ،
phrases.english: knowing that pardoning great sins is nothing great for Thee.

phrases.arabic: وَأَنَّ التَّجَـاوُزَ عَنِ الإثْمِ الْجَلِيْلِ لا يَسْتَصْعِبُكَ ،
phrases.english: overlooking enormous misdeeds is not difficult for thee

phrases.arabic: وَأَنَّ احْتِمَالَ الْجنَايَاتِ الْفَـاحِشَةِ لا يَتَكَأَّدُكَ،
phrases.english: putting up with indecent crimes does not trouble Thee,

phrases.arabic: وَأَنَّ أَحَبَّ عِبَادِكَ إلَيْكَ مَنْ تَرَكَ الاسْتِكْبَارَ عَلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: and the most beloved of Thy servants to Thee is he who refrains from arrogance before thee

phrases.arabic: وَجَانَبَ الإِصْرَارَ، وَلَزِمَ الاسْتِغْفَارَ.
phrases.english: pulls aside from persistence, and holds fast to praying forgiveness!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنَا أَبْرَأُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَسْتَكْبِرَ،
phrases.english: I am clear before Thee of arrogance,

phrases.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أصِـرَّ.
phrases.english: I seek refuge in Thee from persistence,

phrases.arabic: وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا قَصَّرْتُ فِيهِ ،
phrases.english: I pray forgiveness from Thee for shortcomings,

phrases.arabic: وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَى مَا عَجَزْتُ عَنْهُ.
phrases.english: I seek help from Thee in incapacity!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: O God bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي مَا يَجبُ عَلَيَّ لَكَ ،
phrases.english: dispense with what is incumbent upon me toward Thee,

phrases.arabic: وَعَافِنِي مِمَّا أَسْتَوْجِبُهُ مِنْكَ،
phrases.english: release me from what I merit from Thee,

phrases.arabic: وَأجِرْنِي مِمَّا يَخَافُهُ أَهْلُ الإساءَةِ
phrases.english: and grant me sanctuary from what the evildoers fear!

phrases.arabic: فَإنَّكَ مَلِيءٌ بِالْعَفْوِ، مَرْجُوٌّ لِلْمَغْفِرَةِ، مَعْرُوفٌ بِالتَّجَاوُزِ ،
phrases.english: For Thou art full of pardon, the hoped-for source of forgiveness, well known for Thy forbearance.

phrases.arabic: لَيْسَ لِحَاجَتِي مَطْلَبٌ سِوَاكَ ،
phrases.english: My need has no object but Thee,

phrases.arabic: وَلا لِذَنْبِي غَافِرٌ غَيْرُكَ، َحاشَاكَ
phrases.english: my sin no forgiver other than Thee - could that be possible?

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ أَخَافُ عَلَى نَفْسِي إلاّ إيَّاكَ
phrases.english: I have no fear for myself except from Thee;

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَى وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ .
phrases.english: Thou art worthy of reverential fear, and worthy to forgive!

phrases.arabic: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
phrases.english: Bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَاقْض حَاجَتِي وَأَنْجِحْ طَلِبَتِي،
phrases.english: grant my need,answer my request favorably,

phrases.arabic: وَاغْفِرْ ذَنْبِي، وَآمِنْ خَوْفَ نَفْسِيْ
phrases.english: forgive my sin and give me security from fear for myself!

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ
phrases.english: Thou art powerful over everything,

phrases.arabic: وَذلِكَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ آمِينَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ .
phrases.english: and that is easy for Thee.Amen, Lord of the worlds
